doc:
### PROPOSAL-16 — Y2K Bubblegum Pop - **slug**: `y2k-pop` - **Vibe**: Retro-future early-2000s — pastel pink, sky blue, and lime on glossy bubbles with playful tilt and chrome-lite shine. - **Best for**: Creator Studio and fun launch moments — optimistic, toy-like, social-native. Adjectives: playful, glossy, optimistic. - **Palette** (light theme, `is_dark: false`): | Token | Value | Usage | |---|---|---| | `--bg-canvas` | `#fdeef4` | Pastel pink-white canvas | | `--bg-surface` | `#ffffff` | Card and bubble fill | | `--bg-surface-elevated` | `#fff5fa` | Raised/hover bubbles | | `--border-subtle` | `#f4d9e4` | Soft pastel hairlines | | `--border-default` | `#e0b6c9` | Standard pastel borders | | `--border-focus` | `#4cc9f0` | Sky-blue focus outline | | `--text-primary` | `#23203f` | Ink-navy headings | | `--text-secondary` | `#4a4668` | Body text | | `--text-muted` | `#756c8a` | Captions, helper text | | `--color-action` | `#ff5fa2` | Bubblegum-pink primary action | | `--color-action-hover` | `#e84a8e` | Action hover (deeper pink) | | `--color-earnings` | `#37c96b` | Lime-green earnings | | `--color-earnings-hover` | `#2ba85a` | Earnings hover (deeper lime) | | `--color-automation` | `#4cc9f0` | Sky-blue automation accents | | `--color-alert` | `#ffb020` | Candy-amber warnings | | `--color-danger` | `#e03e6e` | Bubblegum-red failed states | | `--color-action-glow` | `rgba(255, 95, 162, 0.16)` | Pink tint behind action icons | | `--color-earnings-glow` | `rgba(55, 201, 107, 0.14)` | Lime tint behind earnings icons | | `--color-automation-glow` | `rgba(76, 201, 240, 0.14)` | Sky tint behind automation icons | - **Typography**: Display: `"Bungee", "Baloo 2", sans-serif` — chunky rounded display for headings and KPI numerals, weight 400-800. Sans: `"Quicksand", "Nunito", system-ui, sans-serif` at 500-700 — friendly and round. Mono: `"Space Mono", ui-monospace, monospace` for timestamps. Numerals `tabular-nums`; labels uppercase with `letter-spacing: 0.06em`. - **Radii & Borders**: Extra bubbly — cards 24px+, buttons full pill, inputs 16px. Borders are 2px pastel; cards carry a glossy inset top highlight (`inset 0 8px 12px -8px rgba(255,255,255,0.9)`) and a 3D bottom lip shadow (0 6px 0 pastel darker). - **Component Patterns**: - **Buttons**: Glossy bubble pills with a 3D bottom lip (solid 4px darker shadow, no blur) and inset top shine; primary = bubblegum pink with dark ink text (`#23203f`) for AA; hover bounces scale 1.03. Secondary = white with 2px pastel border. Focus = 2px sky outline. - **Cards**: White bubbles with 2px pastel border, glossy top highlight, a subtle -2deg playful tilt on featured cards, and `rounded-[2rem]`. No soft shadows — plastic depth only. - **Badges/Status**: Glossy bubble chips with a dot; publishing = pulsing lime "loading" bubble; published = sky bubble; failed = pink-red bubble. Rounded-full, never square. - **Tables**: Soft pastel zebra rows inside a rounded container; header in bold rounded sans. Row hover = pastel pink wash. - **Forms/Inputs**: Bubbly rounded fields with a glossy inset; focus = sky border. Labels in rounded bold sans. - **Loading**: Three bouncing glossy bubbles; determinate = a segmented candy bar filling left to right. - **Signature detail**: Glossy bubble surfaces + playful tilt + a chrome-lite "Y2K shine" (white gradient streak) across headings — plastic, optimistic, unmistakably 2003. - **Motion & Animation**: Bouncy and springy — 350ms with overshoot (`scale 0.9 -> 1.06 -> 1`); cards tilt further on hover; buttons squash on `:active`. Turbo Stream inserts bounce in; nothing is still for long. - **Signature Preview Snippet**: ```html
EARNINGS!! $12,480
```
